mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month average of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.0%, it indicates a low-rate environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where the 12-month average of FEDFUNDS < 2.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A high real interest rate, indicated by monthly CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 2.0% and FEDFUNDS above 1.5%, compresses equity discount rates and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 1.5% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market is tight, supporting strong corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is rising (3-month rolling increase) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals a contraction in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0 over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1150.0 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 500000.0, it signals a robust housing sector supporting economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1150 and RSAFS > 500000 over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 250.0), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250.0 over the last 5 years.
